stem: Which statement from the selection is best supported by the poem?

options.label: F
options.text: These friendly little birds are often seen at bird feeders throughout the winter. (paragraph 2)

options.label: G
options.text: They are plump-looking critters, with black, white, and gray feathers, and they live year-round in the forests of North America, from Alaska through Canada and across the northern states. (paragraph 2)

options.label: H
options.text: Chickadees begin preparing for winter while the green leaves of summer are still on the trees. (paragraph 8)

options.label: J
options.text: Although fragile in many ways, the tiny black-capped chickadee shows how tough it really is by surviving the bitterly cold winters of northern North America. (paragraph 11)
